name: Trash Inspector
summary:
Welcome to your new job at the recycling plant. It sounds simple. It isn't.

Trash Inspector puts you in front of a conveyor belt that never stops. Bottles, cans, newspapers, cardboard, glass jars and the occasional mystery object come rolling toward you, and it's your job to grab each one and send it to the right bin before the belt gets buried.

SORT WITH YOUR HANDS
